# Balanced or not?

<!-- STEP id="lifter" -->
A weightlifter holds a barbell steady above her head. The Earth pulls the barbell down. Her hands push it up. The barbell does not move, so these two forces are balanced.

<!-- STEP id="wrestle" -->
Two players arm-wrestle. If their hands tilt towards one side, the forces are not balanced. The player pushing towards that side exerts the larger force.
